name: Staking Vault: V1 to V2_PartialBug Upgrade (Single-Actor Regression on Charlie)
description: Tests an upgrade from StakingVaultV1 to StakingVaultV2_PartialBug across 3 legacy stakers. Demonstrates that while Alice and Bob calculate continuous rewards with the approved loyalty bonus, an off-by-one tier condition causes Charlie's reward and eligibility to unexpectedly drop to 0.

expectedChanges.reason: Alice 10% loyalty duration bonus applied backward-compatibly (~66.53 ETH)
Bob 10% loyalty duration bonus applied backward-compatibly (~166.32 ETH)
Charlie 10% loyalty duration bonus applied backward-compatibly (~33.26 ETH)
